prices.label: MCP-02 price assumptions (calculation inputs, not measured bills)
prices.bytes_per_token_note: Estimator: 4 UTF-8 bytes per token for the downstream handoff. Exact handoff bytes are reported separately.
prices.local_price_note: Amortised laptop hardware plus power at roughly 0.30 USD/h for the RTX 5080 laptop GPU and 0.05 USD/h for CPU router inference.

accounting.failure_accounting: every assigned episode contributes cost; cost per success divides by accepted episodes
accounting.token_source: router tokens are hashed-word tokens of the shared encoder; handoff tokens use the configured bytes-per-token estimator
accounting.flops_source: torch FlopCounterMode per candidate times candidates scored
accounting.latency_source: wall clock per router decision on the recorded host
